title: G6 Setup with old transmitter
body:
I just installed xDrip (latest version) and I... have no idea what I'm doing generally but also am not getting readings at all. The Dexcom app said my transmitter needed to be replaced but I read that I could use xDrip+ so I installed it. I did the Start source setup wizard, and during the 2 hour window it asked if I wanted to hard reset the transmitter I said yes. after the two hours I calibrated, but it just said "sensor fail 6" and "waiting for transmitter to receive calibration" for about a day, then I checked off the algo setting, now the "sensor fail 6" is gone but it says "stopped" at the bottom and still has the "waiting" message at the top, even after calibrating 2 times (4 pricks). I also keep getting push notification errors that "calibration rejected:sensor stopped". I've clicked "reset connector" a number of times. 

help?
